candidate.answerReason: Parallelism requires the same-side interior angles to sum to 180°, giving 180°−75°=105°. This supplementary pair also guarantees parallelism.

methods.label: Supplementary-angle criterion
methods.explanation: If same-side interior angles are supplementary, the two lines are parallel, so \(\angle 2=180^\circ-75^\circ=105^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 supplementary-angle criterion and elementary subtraction.
